title: HAMIDIA HOSPITAL
en: Even the doctors did not know which gas it was.
The morning of 3 December. Hamidia Hospital.
Their eyes burned, and their chests felt on fire.
There were not enough beds. Patients lay in corridors and on the floor.
No one had the right treatment for it.
In the first few days alone, tens of thousands needed treatment.
By morning, the lanes of the city had fallen silent.
Thousands of animals died too, and the leaves turned yellow and fell.
